question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Besides having a good academic record, it is important that you learn how to face an interview with ______ and self-confidence.
solution:
The correct answer is **'ease.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Ease** means a lack of difficulty.

 ​ ** -Example:** He didn't feel completely at ease in the strange surroundings.

So, it is clear that the most appropriate word is 'Ease&
